headline: Nevish Line Reignites as Heavy Fighting Engulfs Callums Cape
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the northern sector has seen fresh turbulence as combat flared back to life across Nevish Line, where casualty and enlistment rates accelerated sharply alongside renewed base contests right up to the morning wire. Callums Cape remains an active flashpoint, logging seven strategic shifts across the past two hours amidst contested fighting at Naofa and Scouts Jest. In Mooring County, brutal attrition continues unabated, registering over two thousand combined casualties across two hours with hourly loss rates surging on both flanks. Marban Hollow also maintained steady contestation, yielding additional ownership changes around Checkpoint Bua, while Weathered Expanse recorded further late movement. In contrast, the furious pacing previously seen in Linn of Mercy has cooled significantly to single-digit casualty rates over the past hour, and fronts in Stlican Shelf and Callahan's Passage have largely settled into quiet holding actions with no recent base flips.
